title: Reading — Labels, a Message, and a First Paragraph
label: ch:mr-pahila-paath
canDo: I can read Marathi off a form, off a short message, and through a whole paragraph, without translating word by word.

payoff.summary: Eighty-three words of Marathi in a row with no new word in them — the first time the track asks for a whole paragraph at once.
